app: Briefcase: private AI for law firms, working on the firm's own documents (built on AnythingLLM)

personas.cares_about: Profitability per lawyer, client confidentiality, malpractice and ethics risk.
personas.time_spent: Client work, business development, supervising associates, firm admin.
personas.struggles: Lawyers quietly using public ChatGPT on client files; can't see whether AI saves time or creates risk.
personas.how_helps: Firm insights show hours saved and what they are worth, who uses it, policy acceptance, client consent per matter, a supervision queue and an exportable audit log.

tasks.name: Matter switch rebinds the answer and matter card
Money view, usage by person and AI policy
Filter the audit log by matter
expect: [data-testid='audit-log']:has-text('Asked for account balances at date of death')

tasks.name: Right bar shows period, open risks and exports on Firm

personas.cares_about: Accurate work product fast; billable hours; never citing something that doesn't exist.
personas.time_spent: Reading discovery, deposition transcripts and prior briefs; drafting motions.
personas.struggles: AI tools that hallucinate and can't see the firm's own matter documents.
personas.how_helps: Ask the matter: every sentence cites a page with Bates number; conflicting evidence and 'not found' are shown instead of a guess.

tasks.name: Ask Reyes: cited answer, conflict note and not-found guard
Switching to Estate of D. Liu replaces the Reyes answer
Search opens a real results panel
Associates cannot open Admin
Citation opens the exact page with Bates number

personas.cares_about: Deadlines, organized files, chronologies the attorneys trust.
personas.time_spent: Building chronologies, indexing documents, calendaring deadlines.
personas.struggles: Chronologies take days and every entry must point to a document.
personas.how_helps: Timeline per matter with key dates (SOL with rule), deadlines with rule and verified-by, filters, export, and each event's source page.

tasks.name: Reyes timeline with key dates and verified deadline
Filter to testimony and export
Bell badge equals the deadlines listed this week
Switching matter rebuilds the timeline
Clicking an event shows its source

personas.cares_about: Booking good cases quickly and avoiding conflicts.
personas.time_spent: Calls, intake forms, conflict checks, scheduling consults.
personas.struggles: Conflict checks across old matters are slow and manual.
personas.how_helps: Intake queue with AI call summaries, fit signals, SOL with state and rule for attorney check, a conflict search with near matches that an attorney must clear, and consult booking.

tasks.name: Summary, SOL with rule, and conflict pending attorney
Request clearance and book with a named attorney
Intake role cannot open matter documents
Next caller in the queue gets her own summary; decline path

personas.cares_about: Captured time, realization rate, clean invoices.
personas.time_spent: Chasing lawyers for time entries, prebills, collections.
personas.struggles: Lawyers forget to record time; AI-assisted work is hard to describe on a bill.
personas.how_helps: Time suggests entries from measured lawyer time (not AI time) with timekeeper, client-matter, UTBMS code, rate and amount; edit, approve, reject, undo.

tasks.name: Prebill-ready rows with measured time and codes
expect: text=Bill actual time only (ABA Formal Op. 512)

tasks.name: Approve changes the row state and the totals
Billing cannot open matter documents
Timekeeper summary in the right bar

personas.cares_about: Security, integrations with the DMS and practice-management tools, vendor risk.
personas.time_spent: Vendor reviews, user access, keeping Clio/NetDocuments running.
personas.struggles: Vendors that can't say where data goes or which model sees it.
personas.how_helps: Admin states the data flow precisely, names the model, vendor and region, gives trust documents, integration health, users and roles, and the in-instance model option.

tasks.name: Data flow, model, trust documents, integrations, users
Connect iManage changes its state
Same Admin is blocked when viewing as associate
Instance health in the right bar

personas.cares_about: Volume of cases handled well; clients who understand their status.
personas.struggles: Translating and re-explaining letters to clients takes hours each week.
personas.how_helps: Draft from the matter's own templates with cited facts, side-by-side Spanish, review gates before sending by the client's channel, and batch letters.

tasks.name: Draft is bound to the selected matter and needs review
Side-by-side Spanish is marked not yet reviewed
Approve, review translation, send by WhatsApp
Batch letters go to a review queue
Selecting Reyes switches the draft away from Herrera

personas.role: Solo in-house counsel at a 300-person company
personas.cares_about: Contract turnaround for sales; consistent positions.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing NDAs, MSAs and vendor contracts against the playbook.
personas.struggles: Same redlines every week; the playbook lives in her head.
personas.how_helps: In-house workspace: contract requests with requester, deal and due date; review against the company playbook with section quotes, fallbacks, approvers and per-row accept.

tasks.name: In-house workspace with request header
Accept a row updates the redline button
Another request shows its own clauses
Loading state while a contract is indexing
Clause detail with fallback and approver in the right bar

personas.role: Firm administrator / office manager (often the actual buyer at 5-30 lawyer firms)
personas.cares_about: Overhead per lawyer, vendor cost vs value, staff productivity, smooth onboarding.
personas.time_spent: Vendor contracts, HR, onboarding staff, managing software subscriptions and IT providers.
personas.struggles: Can't compare AI vendors on cost and risk; seats bought and not used.
personas.how_helps: Plan and billing view with seats bought and active, monthly cost, cost per active user and per hour saved, invoices, onboarding checklist and the security pack for partners.

tasks.name: Plan, seats and cost per hour saved
Download invoice and security pack
Invite users who are not onboarded
Firm administrator does not see matter documents

personas.role: Firm general counsel / ethics or risk partner
personas.cares_about: Malpractice exposure, compliance with ABA Op. 512 and state bar guidance, insurer questionnaires.
personas.time_spent: Conflicts clearance, policy writing, answering malpractice carrier and client outside-counsel-guideline questionnaires.
personas.struggles: Clients' outside counsel guidelines restrict or require disclosure of AI; no record of which matters used AI.
personas.how_helps: Per-matter AI-use register with client positions, AI blocked on restricted matters, and exportable evidence for carriers and clients.

tasks.name: Filter register to client-restricted matters and export
AI is actually off inside the restricted matter
Draft and review are blocked there too
Open risks in the right bar

personas.time_spent: Reading court orders and notices, entering and checking deadlines across all matters.
personas.struggles: Orders arrive by email/e-filing and must be read and calculated by hand; double entry with the calendar system.
personas.how_helps: Cross-matter queue of AI-extracted deadlines with rule and source page, verified by the clerk before posting to the firm calendar.

tasks.name: Cross-matter verify queue with rule and source
Verify, then post to the calendar
Badge equals this week's listed deadlines
Source page of a queued deadline

personas.cares_about: Quality and currency of templates, precedents and playbooks the AI draws on.
personas.time_spent: Curating the brief bank and templates, retiring outdated forms, training lawyers.
personas.struggles: AI may reuse outdated templates or superseded briefs; no way to mark the authoritative version.
personas.how_helps: Knowledge view with authoritative / superseded / retired status, usage counts and which recent drafts used each template.

tasks.name: See template status and usage
Retire a superseded template
See which recent drafts used it

personas.role: Legal secretary / legal assistant to two partners
personas.cares_about: Getting letters, filings and client updates out on time and correctly formatted.
personas.struggles: Re-typing facts from the file into letters; firm style formatting.
personas.how_helps: Drafts in firm style with facts filled from the matter and cited, sent to the attorney for sign-off, exported on letterhead.

tasks.name: Generate a client update letter for Reyes
Send to the partner for review, then export on letterhead
Secretaries cannot approve or send to the client
Fields and sources in the right bar

personas.cares_about: Accurate asset inventories, deadlines in probate, client communication with families.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing financial statements, wills, trusts; preparing inventories and court filings.
personas.struggles: Pulling assets and beneficiaries out of hundreds of statements.
personas.how_helps: Ask the estate's documents for an asset and beneficiary list with citations; export a cited inventory.

tasks.name: Select Estate of D. Liu and get the cited inventory
Export the cited inventory
Probate deadline rolled to a business day, flagged to verify
Right bar matter card is the estate's

personas.cares_about: Defensible review, privilege protection, production deadlines.
personas.time_spent: Loading productions, running searches, privilege logs.
personas.struggles: Large productions; privileged documents leaking into answers or drafts.
personas.how_helps: Index productions by Bates range, exclude privileged folders from Ask and drafts, and see the exact scope of every answer.

tasks.name: See productions and Bates ranges in scope
Load a new production volume
Exclude the privileged folder and check the Ask scope
Sources list Bates numbers
